question.text: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of the Reverse Mortgage Loan Enabled Annuity (RMLEA)?

answer.text: It provides lifetime payouts through an annuity from an insurance company
The annuity received is exempt from income tax
The borrower must be at least 65 years of age to be eligible
The borrower can choose between lifetime annuity with or without return of purchase price

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes RMLEA as available to senior citizens over and above 60 years, with a lifetime annuity routed through an insurance company, tax-exempt annuity receipts, and the borrower's choice of annuity with or without return of purchase price. So the 65-year claim is the only feature that does not match the workbook. The Trap: The other three options describe genuine RMLEA features taken straight from the workbook. Note: Based on NISM Series X-B workbook pp.118-120, which set out the RMLEA eligibility age and features.
